card.name: Separators inside lists of psychiatric symptoms
card.fires_on: Commas, semicolons, and linking words like 'or' and 'and' inside lists of depression, suicidality or autism-related symptoms and behaviors. It also fires on 'experience' right after 'may' in antidepressant warnings.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or semicolon between items in a list of symptoms or measured behaviors.
modes.example: include sad mood<<,>> hopelessness, feelings of guilt, worth

modes.label: Linking words in symptom lists
modes.description: 'or' or 'and' that joins another symptom or ability to a list.
modes.example: especially if these symptoms are severe, abrupt in onset,<< or>> were not part of the patient's presenting

modes.label: Verb before worsening
modes.description: The verb 'experience' after 'may' in warnings about worsening depression.
modes.example: both adult and pediatric, may<< experience>> worsening of their depression and/or the emergence
